entities.name: Query protein 505 aa
observations: Sequence length is 505 aa; estimated molecular mass is 55.44 kDa.
Theoretical pI is 6.44 and estimated charge at pH 7 is -3.19.
Pfam evidence identifies YjeF_N at residues 26–191 and Carb_kinase at residues 252–496; Phos_pyr_kinase-like signal occurs at residues 366–464.
Closest reviewed homologs are bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes Nnr with 33.0–35.0% identity and 100% query coverage.

entities.name: Bifunctional Nnr
observations: Reviewed homolog annotations describe epimerization of R- and S-NAD(P)HX and ADP-dependent dehydration of S-NAD(P)HX to regenerate NAD(P)H, producing AMP and phosphate.
The enzyme is annotated with EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136 and binds one potassium ion per subunit.
The N-terminal region is annotated as the NAD(P)H-hydrate epimerase module and the C-terminal region as the ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase module.

entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair
observations: The inferred biological role is metabolite repair of enzymatically or thermally hydrated NADH/NADPH, within nicotinamide nucleotide metabolism.
Reported GO terms include NAD(P)HX epimerase activity, ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity, and metabolite repair.

entities.name: Potassium binding
observations: Reviewed Nnr homologs are annotated to bind one K+ ion per subunit; this is transferred as homology-based evidence, not direct experimental evidence for the query sequence.
